This service agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of the effective date clause specified below, by and between the following parties:

PROVIDER: Apex Advisory Group, LLC ("Provider")
CLIENT: Pinnacle Industries, Inc. ("Client")

RECITALS

WHEREAS, Client desires to engage Provider for consulting agreement services, including advisory document preparation, analysis of documents, legal research, corporate governance analysis, risk management, regulatory compliance, legal compliance, and compliance investigation services;

WHEREAS, Provider is a law firm with expertise in civil litigation, merger and acquisition, due diligence, real estate, intellectual property assets, patent assets, trademark management, copyright management, and knowledge management;

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

ARTICLE I — DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 Defined Terms. Capitalized terms used herein shall have the meanings set forth in this Agreement. The headings clause shall not affect interpretation.

1.2 Confidential Information. "Confidential Information" has the meaning set forth in the confidentiality clause and the confidentiality agreement attached hereto as Exhibit A. The nondisclosure agreement governs all confidential matter narrative materials.

ARTICLE II — SERVICES AND SCOPE

2.1 Services. Provider shall perform the following services: legal research, caselaw research management, brief analysis management, opinion memo practice, analysis of documents, document management, records management, matter management, billing management, and legal project management.

2.2 Attorney Personnel. Provider shall assign a billing attorney and billing partner with relevant area of law expertise. Provider may also assign paralegal support.

2.3 Performance Standards. Provider shall exercise fiduciary duty, duty of care, and duty of loyalty in performing services. Provider shall comply with the business judgment rule and all applicable regulatory compliance and legal compliance obligations.

ARTICLE III — FEES AND PAYMENT

3.1 Payment. Client shall pay attorney fees in accordance with the billing and payment terms clause and payment clause. The retainer agreement governs advance payments.

3.2 Audit. Client shall have the right to audit Provider's invoices pursuant to the audit clause.

ARTICLE IV — REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

4.1 Mutual Representations. Each party makes the representations and warranties set forth herein. Provider represents that it maintains attorney-client privilege and attorney work product protection for all client materials.

4.2 Warranty. The warranty clause governs all representations. No waiver clause shall be construed as a waiver of any breach of contract or breach of fiduciary duty claim.

ARTICLE V — INDEMNIFICATION AND LIABILITY

5.1 Indemnification. The indemnification clause governs indemnity obligations. Each party shall indemnify the other for negligence, fraud, and misrepresentation.

5.2 Limitation of Liability. The limitation of liability clause limits consequential damages. Neither party shall be liable for force majeure events as defined in the force majeure clause.

5.3 Insurance. Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance sufficient to cover attorney malpractice claim exposure.

ARTICLE VI — TERM AND TERMINATION

6.1 Term. This Agreement shall commence on the commencement date and continue for the term specified in the extension clause, subject to the renewal option clause.

6.2 Termination. Either party may terminate pursuant to the termination clause, early termination clause, or default clause. The cure period clause provides for notice and opportunity to cure.

6.3 Survival. The survival clause governs obligations surviving termination.

ARTICLE VII — DISPUTE RESOLUTION

7.1 Dispute Resolution. All disputes shall be resolved pursuant to the dispute resolution clause. The parties shall first attempt good faith negotiation clause and amicable resolution clause procedures. If unresolved, disputes shall be submitted to arbitration pursuant to the arbitration clause.

7.2 Remedies. The remedies clause governs available relief, including specific performance clause and injunction.

ARTICLE VIII — GENERAL PROVISIONS

8.1 Assignment. The assignment clause governs assignment. The no assignment clause prohibits assignment without consent.

8.2 Entire Agreement. The entire agreement clause constitutes the complete agreement. The merger clause and integration clause supersede all prior agreements.

8.3 Amendment. The amendment clause governs modifications to this Agreement.

8.4 Governing Law. The governing law clause designates applicable law. The choice of law clause and choice of forum clause govern jurisdiction.

8.5 Severability. The severability clause governs unenforceability of any provision.

8.6 Waiver. The waiver clause governs waivers. The no waiver clause prevents implied waivers.

8.7 Notices. All notices shall be delivered pursuant to the notice of motion and notice of hearing procedures.

8.8 Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts pursuant to the approval signatures clause.

8.9 Publicity. The publicity clause governs public disclosures.

8.10 Condition Precedent. The condition precedent clause governs conditions to closing.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the effective date clause.

PROVIDER: ________________________
CLIENT: ________________________

SERVICES AGREEMENT

This service agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of the effective date clause specified below, by and between the following parties:

PROVIDER:

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements set forth herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

ARTICLE I — DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 Defined Terms.
Capitalized terms used herein shall have the meanings set forth in this Agreement.
The headings clause shall not affect interpretation.
1.2 Confidential Information.
"Confidential Information" has the meaning set forth in the confidentiality clause and the confidentiality agreement attached hereto as Exhibit A.
The nondisclosure agreement governs all confidential matter narrative materials.

ARTICLE II — SERVICES AND SCOPE

2.1 Services.

Provider shall perform the following services: legal research, caselaw research management, brief analysis management, opinion memo practice, analysis of documents, document management, records management, matter management, billing management, and legal project management.
2.2 Attorney Personnel.
Provider shall assign a billing attorney and billing partner with relevant area of law expertise.
Provider may also assign paralegal support.
2.3 Performance Standards.
Provider shall exercise fiduciary duty, duty of care, and duty of loyalty in performing services.
Provider shall comply with the business judgment rule and all applicable regulatory compliance and legal compliance obligations.

ARTICLE III — FEES AND PAYMENT

3.1 Payment.
Client shall pay attorney fees in accordance with the billing and payment terms clause and payment clause.
The retainer agreement governs advance payments.
3.2 Audit.
Client shall have the right to audit Provider's invoices pursuant to the audit clause.

ARTICLE IV — REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

4.1 Mutual Representations.
Each party makes the representations and warranties set forth herein.
Provider represents that it maintains attorney-client privilege and attorney work product protection for all client materials.
4.2 Warranty.
The warranty clause governs all representations.
No waiver clause shall be construed as a waiver of any breach of contract or breach of fiduciary duty claim.

ARTICLE V — INDEMNIFICATION AND LIABILITY

5.1 Indemnification.
The indemnification clause governs indemnity obligations.
Each party shall indemnify the other for negligence, fraud, and misrepresentation.
5.2 Limitation of Liability.
The limitation of liability clause limits consequential damages.
Neither party shall be liable for force majeure events as defined in the force majeure clause.
5.3 Insurance.
Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance sufficient to cover attorney malpractice claim exposure.

ARTICLE VI — TERM AND TERMINATION

6.1 Term.
This Agreement shall commence on the commencement date and continue for the term specified in the extension clause, subject to the renewal option clause.
6.2 Termination.
Either party may terminate pursuant to the termination clause, early termination clause, or default clause.
The cure period clause provides for notice and opportunity to cure.
6.3 Survival.
The survival clause governs obligations surviving termination.

ARTICLE VII — DISPUTE RESOLUTION

7.1 Dispute Resolution.
All disputes shall be resolved pursuant to the dispute resolution clause.
The parties shall first attempt good faith negotiation clause and amicable resolution clause procedures.

If unresolved, disputes shall be submitted to arbitration pursuant to the arbitration clause.

7.2 Remedies.
The remedies clause governs available relief, including specific performance clause and injunction.

ARTICLE VIII — GENERAL PROVISIONS

8.1 Assignment.
The assignment clause governs assignment.
The no assignment clause prohibits assignment without consent.
8.2 Entire Agreement.
The entire agreement clause constitutes the complete agreement.
The merger clause and integration clause supersede all prior agreements.
8.3 Amendment.
The amendment clause governs modifications to this Agreement.
8.4 Governing Law.
The governing law clause designates applicable law.
The choice of law clause and choice of forum clause govern jurisdiction.
8.5 Severability.
The severability clause governs unenforceability of any provision.
8.6 Waiver.
The waiver clause governs waivers.
The no waiver clause prevents implied waivers.
8.7 Notices.
All notices shall be delivered pursuant to the notice of motion and notice of hearing procedures.
8.8 Counterparts.
This Agreement may be executed in counterparts pursuant to the approval signatures clause.
8.9 Publicity.
The publicity clause governs public disclosures.
8.10 Condition Precedent.
The condition precedent clause governs conditions to closing.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the effective date clause.
